package config

import "testing"

func validConfig() Config {
	return Config{
		OutboxBatchSize:              50,
		OutboxLockTTLSeconds:         300,
		OutboxPollIntervalMS:         250,
		OutboxRetryBaseSeconds:       1,
		OutboxRetryMaxSeconds:        300,
		OutboxPublishTimeoutSeconds:  5,
		PracticeTaskInternalToken:    "practice-token",
		CourseDiagnosticCatalogToken: "diagnostic-catalog-token",
	}
}

func TestValidateRequiresDedicatedDiagnosticCatalogToken(t *testing.T) {
	cfg := validConfig()
	cfg.CourseDiagnosticCatalogToken = ""
	if err := cfg.Validate(); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected missing diagnostic catalog token")
	}
	cfg.CourseDiagnosticCatalogToken = cfg.PracticeTaskInternalToken
	if err := cfg.Validate(); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected shared diagnostic catalog token")
	}
}

func TestValidateRequiresDedicatedPracticeToken(t *testing.T) {
	cfg := validConfig()
	cfg.PracticeTaskInternalToken = ""
	if err := cfg.Validate(); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected missing Practice token to be rejected")
	}
	cfg.PracticeTaskInternalToken = "shared-token"
	cfg.CourseServiceInternalToken = "shared-token"
	if err := cfg.Validate(); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected duplicate Practice token to be rejected")
	}
}

func TestValidateAcceptsOutboxLeaseThatCoversBatch(t *testing.T) {
	if err := validConfig().Validate(); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Validate returned error: %v", err)
	}
}

func TestValidateRejectsOutboxLeaseEqualToBatchTimeout(t *testing.T) {
	cfg := validConfig()
	cfg.OutboxLockTTLSeconds = cfg.OutboxBatchSize * cfg.OutboxPublishTimeoutSeconds
	if err := cfg.Validate(); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected invalid outbox lease error")
	}
}

func TestValidateRequiresDedicatedLearningPlannerToken(t *testing.T) {
	cfg := validConfig()
	cfg.CourseServiceInternalToken = "shared-token"
	cfg.LearningPlannerInternalToken = "shared-token"
	if err := cfg.Validate(); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected duplicate internal token to be rejected")
	}
}

func TestLearningWorkspaceSnapshotDefaultsOff(t *testing.T) {
	if validConfig().LearningWorkspaceSnapshotEnabled {
		t.Fatal("learning workspace snapshot must default off")
	}
}

func TestHTTPListenAddressPreservesDefaultAndAllowsLoopbackAdapter(t *testing.T) {
	cfg := validConfig()
	cfg.HTTPPort = "8081"
	if got := cfg.HTTPListenAddress(); got != ":8081" {
		t.Fatalf("default listen address = %q, want :8081", got)
	}
	cfg.HTTPBindAddress = "127.0.0.1"
	if got := cfg.HTTPListenAddress(); got != "127.0.0.1:8081" {
		t.Fatalf("loopback listen address = %q, want 127.0.0.1:8081", got)
	}
}

func TestLearningWorkspaceSnapshotRequiresDedicatedTeacherTokenWhenEnabled(t *testing.T) {
	cfg := validConfig()
	cfg.LearningWorkspaceSnapshotEnabled = true
	if err := cfg.Validate(); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected enabled workspace snapshot to require the Teacher token")
	}
	cfg.TeacherInternalToken = "teacher-token"
	if err := cfg.Validate(); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Validate with Teacher token: %v", err)
	}
}

func TestValidateRequiresDedicatedTeacherToken(t *testing.T) {
	for _, other := range []struct {
		name    string
		teacher string
		course  string
		planner string
	}{
		{name: "course", teacher: "shared-token", course: "shared-token"},
		{name: "planner", teacher: "shared-token", planner: "shared-token"},
	} {
		t.Run(other.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			cfg := validConfig()
			cfg.TeacherInternalToken = other.teacher
			cfg.CourseServiceInternalToken = other.course
			cfg.LearningPlannerInternalToken = other.planner
			if err := cfg.Validate(); err == nil {
				t.Fatal("expected duplicate Teacher token to be rejected")
			}
		})
	}
}
